Coins are earned, not bought twice. When you order followers or likes, the coins you spend become the prize pool. Your profile or video goes into the Tasks list, other users open that link and follow or like it for real, and the coins move to them once the app checks the follow or like actually happened.
If you want to grow your account
Followers for a profile, or likes for one video.
Open Store, choose the Profile or Video tab, then pick a package. Pay with coins, or with Google Play for the larger ones.
Followers go to your connected account. For likes, paste the link to one video: tap the video card, paste the link, tap Add Video.
Place the order. It shows up immediately in More → My orders with its progress.
Your profile or video then appears in other users\' Tasks. They open it, follow or like it, and your order counter goes up.
If you want to earn coins
Then spend those coins on your own profile.
Open Tasks. Each card shows the account to follow or the video to like, and how many coins it pays.
Tap Follow or Like. TikTok opens on that profile or video — do the follow or like there.
Come back to the app and tap Check. The app verifies the follow or like before paying, so the coins land a moment later.
Top up free with the daily reward: More → Daily reward gives you 100 coins every day.

The app never pays for a follow or like it cannot see — it compares the counts before and after, so nothing is paid twice and nothing is paid for nothing.

If you skip a task it comes back later, up to two times, before it leaves your list. An order that has not been verified stays in progress rather than disappearing.

To keep the cycle working for everyone: complete the tasks you start, and keep your linked account public — a private account cannot be checked.
